stage: Desktop same-batch pairing, preview, execution, persistence and plotting/export integration
verification_sequence: Full ten-target run followed by affected-target reruns: scientific catalogue expectation updated to 54; missing bilingual psd_trend.none labels added and parameter references regenerated. Final summaries use each target latest successful run.

generated_parameter_references.status: current; cross-spectrum is registered in the public task catalogue

interface_coverage: MainWindow: two CSV files, explicit grouping, preview, RunController, database and result page
Stable source identity across reordering and import-option edits; remove/reimport does not substitute an old member
Missing, self, duplicate and out-of-scope pair validation; preview uses only its selected two inputs
Pair dialog selects actual dataset UUID and upstream output port; same-name candidates are disambiguated
Dual input preview matches chosen alternative output, handles parameter changes and discards superseded callbacks
Ordinary descendants after a pair preserve preview selection and pair-level record assembly
Production batch persistence isolates a bad-grid pair from successful pairs
Cancelled pending records do not invent algorithm execution history
Pending numerical payload budget cancels remaining work instead of retaining unbounded unsaved record output
Cross-spectrum database reload restores full schema, units and masks
Metric selection preserves appearance, breaks undefined cells and wrapped phase, and handles all-undefined metrics
Synchronous and asynchronous CSV export retain all eight columns and units; PNG and PDF use the selected metric
Existing core, analysis, UI, style export, workspace, integration and updater regression suites

fixed_integration_issue.issue: The figure export gateway rejected every Table output, including the typed cross-spectrum table.
fixed_integration_issue.resolution: Permit the cross_spectrum port through the gateway, then require validated typed data and a renderable metric in PlotView; ordinary tables remain CSV-only.
fixed_integration_issue.regression: asyncCsvAndDatabaseReload exports the stored pair as PDF; plotMetricMasksAndExport exports PNG and checks phase/style state.

compatibility.pair_record_snapshot: Executed result suffix, not a replayable single-input workflow; complete frozen graph and source/group manifest kept in provenance.

resource_guards.save_failure: Retain retryable record and cooperatively cancel remaining jobs; running tasks may still complete.

limitations: Windows and macOS native build, actual graphics drivers, input methods and clean-host deployment have not been tested in this stage.
No claim that all possible algorithms or real-world datasets are verified; this stage exercises the existing regression suites and the listed new interfaces.
Extended real-data acceptance, save-failure/retry stress testing and large-batch profiling remain later checks.
No new sanitizer run in alpha.3; alpha.2 numerical sanitizer results have their own narrower scope.
Same upstream source batch only; no cross-root joins, pair-after-pair grouping, automatic alignment, significance thresholds, MTM cross-spectrum or cross-wavelet.
Source UUIDs are stable in the current document session and stored in run provenance; this stage does not add project save/load.
Source manifests preserve references and options, not immutable copies of source-file bytes.
logs: Local workspace and temporary paths replaced with placeholders; test status and totals preserved.
